spec: Azy Skin for Adobe Premiere Pro - Complete Implementation Specification
note: Single source of truth for docs/progress.html and docs/PROGRESS.md. Edit the items, run tools/progress.py, commit all three. status: done | partial | todo | blocked | impossible. class: A (done/possible), B (possible, planned), C (approximation only), D (not possible - forbidden techniques, excluded from the totals).

out_of_scope.why: Clips and the playhead are painted by Premiere inside one window. Recolouring them means hooking its renderer - the definition of what this project does not do. Closest alternative: the timeline band, its separators and an accent line for the selected track.

out_of_scope.spec: §14-15 Dropdown and context menus as glass cards
out_of_scope.why: Those popups belong to Premiere's process and are themed by Windows. No supported external theming exists. They stay exactly as they are.

out_of_scope.spec: §13 Buttons, §19 sliders/checkboxes/keyframes, §18 search field, §21 toolbar icons
out_of_scope.why: Premiere's own drawing, with no HWND behind them. Alternative: region chrome around them (separators, bands, accents), which is what class C delivers.
Windows can blur only a process's own window. Blurring Premiere's pixels requires constant screen capture and reprojection - explicitly ruled out. Alternative: static gradients that read as depth.

out_of_scope.spec: §11 Panel hover/active/focus states on Premiere's panels
out_of_scope.why: Premiere's panels never tell an outside process that the pointer is over them. Alternative: focus-aware treatment of the tracked window as a whole (active window vs. inactive), which is measurable.
